mapper.insert: MERGE INTO wo_view_doc_cache T USING (SELECT CAST(#{row.fileHash} AS VARCHAR(64)) AS FILE_HASH) S ON (T.FILE_HASH = S.FILE_HASH) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET DOC_TYPE = #{row.docType}, SNAPSHOT_GZIP = #{row.snapshotGzip}, BYTE_SIZE = #{row.byteSize}, MADE_MS = #{row.madeMs}, ENCRYPTED_YN = #{row.encryptedYn}, INPUT_DATETIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INPUT_USER = #{userKey} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( FILE_HASH, DOC_TYPE, SNAPSHOT_GZIP, BYTE_SIZE, MADE_MS, ENCRYPTED_YN, INPUT_DATETIME, INPUT_USER ) VALUES ( #{row.fileHash}, #{row.docType}, #{row.snapshotGzip}, #{row.byteSize}, #{row.madeMs}, #{row.encryptedYn}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{userKey} )

INSERT INTO wo_view_doc_cache ( FILE_HASH, DOC_TYPE, SNAPSHOT_GZIP, BYTE_SIZE, MADE_MS, ENCRYPTED_YN, INPUT_DATETIME, INPUT_USER ) VALUES ( #{row.fileHash}, #{row.docType}, #{row.snapshotGzip}, #{row.byteSize}, #{row.madeMs}, #{row.encryptedYn}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{userKey} ) ON CONFLICT (FILE_HASH) DO UPDATE SET DOC_TYPE = EXCLUDED.DOC_TYPE, SNAPSHOT_GZIP = EXCLUDED.SNAPSHOT_GZIP, BYTE_SIZE = EXCLUDED.BYTE_SIZE, MADE_MS = EXCLUDED.MADE_MS, ENCRYPTED_YN = EXCLUDED.ENCRYPTED_YN, INPUT_DATETIME = EXCLUDED.INPUT_DATETIME, INPUT_USER = #{userKey}
